description: This file defines an abstract class for evaluating continued fractions using the modified Lentz algorithm. It provides methods to evaluate the continued fraction at a specific point, with configurable precision and iteration limits, and includes abstract methods for subclasses to specify the coefficients of the fraction.

classes.name: ContinuedFraction
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework to evaluate continued fractions with customizable coefficients.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction at a given point with optional epsilon and maximum iteration constraints.

methods.name: getA
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the n-th 'a' coefficient, possibly functions of the evaluation point.

methods.name: getB
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the n-th 'b' coefficient, possibly functions of the evaluation point.
